2. The petitioner alleges willful and
deliberate non-compliance of this Court's
order dated 18.12.2025, passed in WPSB No.
637 of 2024, Pramod Kumar Joshi Vs. State of
Uttarakhand and others, whereby, relying
upon the statement made by the then Chief
Standing Counsel Mr. C.S. Rawat, the
petitioner was granted liberty to make a
representation for his reengagement to the
Director, Technical Education and the
Director, Technical Education was directed to
revisit the issue, relied upon the statement
made by the then Chief Standing Counsel, in
the factual background of the case.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner
submits that the petitioner filed a
representation in the Director Technical

Education on 05.03.2026, the postal receipt
sending the representation is also annexed
with the contempt petition. Despite sending
the representation on 05.03.2026, till date no
action has been taken by the respondent-Director, Technical Education, which resulted
into filing the present contempt petition.
4. Issue notice to the respondent-contemnor returnable within four weeks.
5. Steps to be taken within three days.
6. List this case on 29.09.2026.
7. In the meantime, respondent-contemnor
may file response or comply with the order.
